content.title: About
content.content: Dove is a well‑known skin‑care brand celebrated for its gentle, nourishing formulas. The fried version (947) is a scented cream‑paste that is lightly toasted to a golden crust while retaining the beneficial properties of the original product.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Dove was launched in 1957 by Unilever.
The fried (947) edition was introduced in 2023 as a limited‑edition release.
The product contains 5 % natural shea butter, which helps lock in moisture.
Packaging is made from recyclable plastic, reducing environmental impact.
Its flavor combines a subtle caramel note with a gentle lavender aroma.

items.title: Moisturizing
items.content: Shea butter and glycerin work together to retain water in the outer skin layers.

items.title: Soothing
items.content: Mild emulsifiers reduce the risk of irritation, even for sensitive skin.

items.title: Antioxidant effect
items.content: Vitamins E and C in the formula help combat free radicals.

items.title: Calming scent
items.content: Lavender in the fragrance promotes relaxation and stress relief.

items.title: Barrier support
items.content: Lipids strengthen the skin’s natural barrier, protecting against moisture loss.

items.title: Allergy to ingredients
items.content: Contains shea butter and fragrance components that may cause allergic reactions.

items.title: High calorie content
items.content: The cream’s oil content makes it relatively calorie‑dense; use in moderation.

items.title: Not for children under 3
items.content: Texture may pose a choking hazard for very young children.

items.title: Eye contact
items.content: May cause irritation if it gets into the eyes; rinse thoroughly with water.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Apply a small amount to clean facial or body skin, gently massage until fully absorbed. For an extra boost, combine with other Dove products.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Once opened, use within 12 months. Discard if the smell or color changes.
